name: Elder Runara
role: Cloister leader (adult bronze dragon in human form)
traits: Wise, patient, protective of the cloister. Appears as an elderly human with white hair in tight braids.
ideals: Peace between chromatic and metallic dragons; redemption for those shaped by violence.
bonds: Dragon's Rest and its residents. The island's lingering draconic magic.
flaws: Reluctant to reveal her true nature; may intervene only when the party is truly defeated.
equipment: Moonstone key (given to party when ready)
summary: Leads Dragon's Rest — secretly an adult bronze dragon. Killed a blue dragon here a century ago and founded the cloister as sanctuary.
backstory: A century ago Runara pleaded with a blue dragon to stop harnessing the island's destructive magic. When he refused, she killed him. Weary of strife, she founded Dragon's Rest. She dreams of peace between dragon kind.
notes:
Attitude: Indifferent → friendly if party protects cloister or takes quests. Hostile if they harm residents.

Secret lair via undersea tunnel (not on map). Never seems to sleep.

Can rescue a defeated party — use sparingly.
